name: Great Lakes Gas Transmission Security Loop Project Phase II
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The system row P0194 is the whole Great Lakes mainline and there is no row for this loop. A 1996 Federal Register notice from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, docket CP96-297, says the sponsor, Great Lakes Gas Transmission Limited Partnership, proposed three 36 inch loops totaling 24.5 miles (2.4, 12.5 and 9.6 miles) in Delta and Mackinac counties, Michigan. They run from mainline milepost 560.3 to 575.2 and 640.1 to 649.7. That is about 39 km of new pipe, above the 25 km threshold. The Energy Information Administration project table of August 2026 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 86) lists the project as completed, in service 1998, 24.5 miles, 36 inch, cost 33.4 million dollars, same docket. The two sources are not fully independent for the status date. The table gives no added capacity, so capacity is left blank. The loops are three separate segments, so start and end are the outer mileposts. Owner is not staged: the entity lookup found no exact match for the operating partnership; P0194 owner is TC Energy [53.55%] and TC PipeLines LP [46.45%] and the loop owner should be set to match once a current source is checked. The Federal Register notice is a proposal, not a completion record; the completion year and cost rest on the Energy Information Administration table alone. Route: no route researched; use route type and accuracy to be set by the route step, loops parallel the existing mainline.
